default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-1478.title: Ichimoku tenkan/kijun cross above the base line
E-1478.hypothesis: Midpoint of the short channel crossing the midpoint of a 3x longer channel, with price on the same side, marks a shift of the dominant flow that slower trend followers join.

E-1479.title: Stochastic %K/%D cross in the extreme zone
E-1479.hypothesis: A %K cross of %D inside the oversold/overbought zone shows the last push is losing force; late stop-chasers are exhausted, so fade into the middle of the range.

E-1480.title: Vortex indicator crossover
E-1480.hypothesis: Vortex compares upward and downward movement against true range; a crossover shows directional movement overtaking the opposite one and trend followers continue it.

E-1481.title: Triple-smoothed momentum zero cross
E-1481.hypothesis: A triple EMA that turns up filters out one-bar noise; the turn marks a persistent shift in the net order flow that is slow to be recognised.

E-1482.title: Force index zero cross
E-1482.hypothesis: Price change times volume, smoothed: its sign change shows that volume is now behind the other side, which tends to persist while the aggressor keeps working the order.

E-1483.title: MACD histogram sign change
E-1483.hypothesis: The histogram turns when momentum of the trend itself changes sign, before the EMAs cross; acting on it catches the start of the next leg.

E-1484.title: Money-flow index extreme re-entry
E-1484.hypothesis: Volume-weighted RSI returning from an extreme means the heavy-volume selling or buying is spent; the side that forced prices there has no more size, so fade back.

E-1485.title: Effort without result absorption fade
E-1485.hypothesis: After a move, a bar with large volume but a small range shows a passive large player absorbing the aggressors; the move runs out and price goes the other way.

E-1486.title: US-open volume surge bar follow
E-1486.hypothesis: Around the New York cash open (10:30-11:30 local) index flow from US participants arrives; a strong-bodied bar with unusual volume is the first push of that flow and is followed.

E-1487.title: Previous clock-block high/low break follow
E-1487.hypothesis: The previous half-hour or hour block is a recent value area; a close outside it means the new block has rejected that value and breakout orders keep pushing.
